title: puccinellia transsilvanica var. arenaria
intro: Puccinellia transsilvanica var. arenaria, commonly known as Sand Broom or Sand Couch Grass, is a perennial grass native to Europe and Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include promoting digestion, reducing inflammation, and soothing respiratory issues. The health benefits of Puccinellia transsilvanica var. arenaria include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve coughs, and calm the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
